# `navigationBar` (Navigation)

<!-- GENERATED by `dart run tool/reference.dart`. Do not edit. -->

Bottom navigation. Put it in `scaffold.bottomBar`; on wide screens the scaffold shows it as a side rail instead.

| Prop | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `destinations` | literal | list of {icon, label} |
| `selected` | value | value returning the selected index (int) |
| `onSelected` | action | gets `value` (int): the tapped index |
| `rail` | literal | the width from which a scaffold shows it as a side rail (default 840), or false to keep it at the bottom; only when written inline in `scaffold.bottomBar` |

Kinds are explained in REFERENCE.md (Widgets). Icons, colors and text variants: style.md.
